title: Bis-Calix[4]arenes: From Ligand Design to the Directed Assembly of a Metal-Organic Trigonal Antiprism

material_class.structural_family: Fe2Ln2 calix[4]arene cluster with a distorted tetrahedral core

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of meta-xylyl bis-calix[4]arene 2 with iron(II) nitrate nonahydrate and gadolinium(III) nitrate hexahydrate in a DMF/MeOH mixture in the presence of Et3N. Single crystals of 5 were obtained by vapour diffusion of petroleum ether into the mother liquor. No numerical reagent amounts are given in the main text.
synthesis.time: 10 min, then 2 h after addition of Et3N
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by vapour diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Vapour diffusion of petroleum ether into the mother liquor.

source_locations.location: SI, Synthesis of benzyl-C[4] and xylyl-tethered bis-C[4] supported clusters 4–6, Synthesis of 5

material_class.structural_family: metal-organic trigonal antiprism built from O-bridged Mn/Dy triangular faces and para-xylyl bis-calix[4]arene linkers

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of para-xylyl bis-calix[4]arene 3 with manganese(II) chloride tetrahydrate and dysprosium(III) chloride hexahydrate in a DMF/MeOH mixture in the presence of Et3N. Single crystals of the Dy analogue 6 were obtained by diffusion of acetonitrile vapour into the reaction mixture. No numerical reagent amounts are given in the main text.
synthesis.time: 10 min, then 2 h after addition of Et3N
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by vapour diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Diffusion of acetonitrile vapour into the reaction mixture.

properties.summary: Disorder and ion anisotropy preclude a quantitative magnetic analysis. Susceptibility indicates weak ferrimagnetic intramolecular exchange. Low-temperature, high-field magnetization tends toward saturation at Smax, and VTVB data show significant nesting. Tails of frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility indicate the onset of slow magnetization relaxation and SMM behaviour.

measurements.name: intramolecular exchange
measurements.conditions: dc susceptibility; quantitative fitting precluded by disorder and anisotropy (Fig. S6)

measurements.name: VTVB nesting
measurements.conditions: variable-temperature, variable-field magnetization plotted versus μB B/kT (Fig. S8)

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility; onset of slow relaxation/SMM behaviour (Fig. S9)

source_locations.location: magnetic discussion of 6, 6(MnGd) and 6(MnTb); Figs. S6-S9

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Manganese-gadolinium analogue of the para-xylyl bis-calix[4]arene trigonal antiprism

material_class.structural_family: gadolinium analogue of the Mn/Ln metal-organic trigonal antiprism 6

synthesis.procedure: Reported as the gadolinium analogue 6(MnGd). It crystallises more rapidly than the dysprosium compound and was selected for scale-up, desolvation and gas-sorption studies. No separate reagent names or amounts are given in the main text.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Mild heating under vacuum before sorption measurements; bulk integrity checked by PXRD (Fig. S10).

properties.summary: Susceptibility shows weak ferrimagnetic intramolecular exchange, and low-temperature, high-field magnetization tends toward saturation at Smax. VTVB nesting is weaker than for the Dy and Tb analogues, and no frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac signal is observed, so slow relaxation is not indicated.

measurements.name: VTVB nesting
measurements.conditions: variable-temperature, variable-field data versus μB B/kT (Fig. S8)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Manganese-terbium analogue of the para-xylyl bis-calix[4]arene trigonal antiprism

material_class.structural_family: terbium analogue of the Mn/Ln metal-organic trigonal antiprism 6

synthesis.procedure: Reported as the terbium analogue 6(MnTb) and compared magnetically with 6 and 6(MnGd). No separate reagent names or amounts are given in the main text.
